profile_text.body:
Synopsys is a public company headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, traded under the ticker SNPS. Its website describes it as delivering comprehensive silicon-to-systems solutions that help innovators accelerate development, reduce risk, and drive breakthroughs. The site presents the company around electronic design automation tools, semiconductor intellectual property, and systems verification.

The site also carries a notice that visitors may be interacting with an AI-powered chatbot that provides general information about Synopsys, including its products and services, and that this information may be incorrect or incomplete. The notice states that the terms of any applicable agreements supersede information provided by the chatbot, and that chats may be accessed by Synopsys and its service providers to customize the experience and improve the tool.

The company's record shows no tracked products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers. It has a registered presence in California, with 281 entries counted there.
